issue.title: Clarify ambiguous developer setup steps
issue.body:
### Summary

Some local development setup steps are easy to misread because the expected
command, working directory, or prerequisite is not always explicit. This issue
tracks small wording improvements so each step has a single, unambiguous
interpretation.

### Scope

Documentation changes only. This issue should not require changes to application
code, runtime configuration, dependency versions, CI behavior, or setup scripts.

### Proposed changes

1. Reword ambiguous steps in the local development setup guide so each step names
   the expected command, working directory, and prerequisite where relevant.
2. Add cross-references between related setup, frontend, backend, and validation
   sections where readers commonly need to jump between them.

### Why

Clearer setup docs lower the barrier for first-time contributors and reduce the
number of repeated setup questions.
